answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 45579 Country: India Title: Use of Interest received from bank, Govt. Question: My daughter got loan from bank for purchasing a house and paying interest on loan. My question is whether I can give money from my income of interest which I received from bank/NSSC to my daughter for making interest payment of her loan. Answer ID: 45579 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 789/622/H=1434) It is haram to take and give interest based loan. However, it is allowable if you give the interest which you have received from the bank to pay the due interest incurred on your daughter. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
